docs.title: VisionFlow-PX4 开发手册
docs.text: 定制化 PX4 Autopilot 分支，由 WindyLab 开发。将无人机与机械臂（Gamma 系列）在 Gazebo 仿真中集成用于操作任务，具备 Prescribed Performance Guidance and Management Estimator (PreGME) 控制和 ROS2 集成能力。

docs.title: 核心特性
docs.text:
• PreGME 控制器 — 以滑模预设性能控制 (PPC) 算法完全替代标准 mc_att_control 和 mc_pos_control，包含质心补偿和复合误差状态观测器 (CESO)
  • Gamma 机械臂集成 — 通过 gamma_arm_dynamics 库实现 PX4 飞行控制与 Gamma 系列机械臂动力学的深度耦合
  • 丰富的 Gazebo 仿真 — 定制世界、模型和插件，用于室内实验室操作场景（降落箱、VLA 任务、硬件在环）
  • ROS2 生态系统 — Zenoh 中间件、uXRCE-DDS 客户端以及完整的 ROS2 Humble Docker 环境

docs.title: 与标准 PX4 的关键区别
docs.text:
1. PreGME 控制器 — 滑模 PPC 取代标准 MC 控制器（核心研究贡献）
  2. 机械臂集成 — gamma_arm_dynamics 桥接飞行控制与机械臂动力学
  3. Gazebo 仿真 — 定制世界、模型、插件，专为室内实验室操作设计
  4. ROS2 集成 — Zenoh 中间件、uXRCE-DDS、Gazebo-ROS 桥接、完整 ROS2 Humble Docker
  5. 相机反馈管道 — OAK-D 和 Intel RealSense 支持，具备地理标记功能
  6. 差动小车支持 — 完整的差动小车控制栈

docs.title: uORB 消息总线
docs.text: uORB（micro Object Request Broker）是 PX4 的内部消息总线，采用发布-订阅模式。

docs.title: 消息数量
docs.text:
• 总计约 180+ .msg 文件
  • 包括标准 PX4 消息和自定义消息

docs.title: 自定义消息
docs.text: 消息 用途 发布者 ArmJointState.msg 机械臂关节状态 gamma_arm_dynamics CollisionConstraints.msg 碰撞避免约束 pregme_pos_control NeuralControl.msg 神经网络控制调试 mc_nn_control TrajectorySetpoint6dof.msg 6-DOF 轨迹设定值 位置控制器 Rover* 系列 小车专用控制消息 rover_differential

docs.title: Zenoh 中间件
docs.text: Zenoh 是 DDS 的轻量级替代方案，适用于资源受限的环境。

docs.title: 特点
docs.text:
• 低开销，适合嵌入式部署
  • 支持 publish-subscribe 和 request-reply 两种模式
  • 可与标准 DDS 互操作

docs.title: 配置
docs.text: Zenoh 模块位于 src/modules/zenoh/，通过 uORB 消息与飞控核心通信。

docs.title: uXRCE-DDS 客户端
docs.text: uXRCE-DDS 通过串行链路（UART/CAN/USB）实现 DDS 通信。

docs.title: 用途
docs.text:
• 将 PX4 数据桥接到远程 ROS2 节点
  • 支持低带宽环境下的实时控制
  • 硬件在环仿真的通信通道

docs.title: 模块
docs.text: 位于 src/modules/uxrce_dds_client/，通过 UDP 端口 14540/14557 与 MAVROS 等工具通信。

docs.title: MAVLink
docs.text: MAVLink 是无人机领域的事实标准通信协议。

docs.text:
source thirdparty/install/setup.bash && \
  ros2 launch mavros px4.launch fcu_url:=udp://:14540@localhost:14557

docs.title: PreGME 控制器
docs.text: PreGME（Prescribed Performance Guidance and Management Estimator）是本项目的主要研究贡献。

docs.title: 预设性能控制（PPC）
docs.text:
PPC 通过变换函数将约束误差映射到无约束空间，确保系统响应始终在预设的性能边界内：

  • 收敛速度 — 通过预设函数控制误差收敛速率
  • 超调量 — 严格限制最大超调
  • 稳态精度 — 保证最终误差小于预定阈值

docs.title: 复合误差状态观测器（CESO）
docs.text:
CESO 估计并补偿系统不确定性和外部扰动：

估计量 说明 惯性矩阵 在线估计飞行器惯性参数变化 扰动观测 估计风扰、机械臂反作用力等 轨迹预设 支持多种预设轨迹模式

docs.title: 标准控制器
docs.text:
标准 PX4 控制器（MPC）保留用于对比测试和降级运行：

模块 说明 mc_att_control 多旋翼姿态控制（MPC） mc_pos_control 多旋翼位置控制（MPC） mc_rate_control 多旋翼速率控制 mc_autotune_attitude_control 自整定姿态控制

docs.text:

# 使用标准控制器
4001_gz_x500              # 使用 mc_att_control + mc_pos_control

docs.title: 双控制器共存
docs.text: 标准 PX4 控制器（mc_att_control / mc_pos_control）与 PreGME 控制器（pregme_att_control / pregme_pos_control）同时存在，通过空机配置选择使用哪个控制器。

docs.title: 模块化架构
docs.text: 每个控制功能独立为一个 PX4 模块，通过 uORB 消息进行通信。这种设计使得： - 新控制器可以并行开发而不影响现有功能 - 传感器模拟器可以独立于控制逻辑 - 机械臂集成通过独立的 Gazebo 插件实现

docs.title: 多层仿真支持
docs.text: 仿真级别 说明 适用场景 SITL 软件在环，PX4 在主机运行 控制器开发、参数调优 Gazebo 完整物理仿真 系统集成测试 HITL 硬件在环，真实飞控接入 固件验证、硬件测试 SIH 仿真器在环 算法原型验证

docs.title: 与标准 PX4 的差异
docs.text:
1. PreGME 控制器 — 滑模 PPC 替代标准 MPC
  2. Gamma 机械臂集成 — gamma_arm_dynamics 桥接飞控与机械臂
  3. 增强仿真栈 — 自定义世界、模型、插件
  4. ROS2 原生集成 — Zenoh、uXRCE-DDS、Gazebo-ROS Bridge
  5. 神经网络控制 — TensorFlow Lite Micro 集成
  6. 差动小车支持 — 完整的地面机器人控制栈

docs.title: 锁步调度器
docs.text:
为确保仿真时序精确同步，所有仿真配置都启用了锁步调度器：

EXTRA_CMAKE_ARGS="-DENABLE_LOCKSTEP_SCHEDULER=ON"

锁步调度器确保： - PX4 控制循环与 Gazebo 仿真步长严格对齐 - 传感器数据在正确的仿真时刻发布 - 执行器命令在正确的时刻应用到物理引擎

services:
  px4-humble-gz:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: docker/Dockerfile.humble-gz
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              capabilities: [gpu]
    volumes:
      - ..:/workspace:rw
      - ccache:/home/px4/.ccache
      - gz_cache:/home/px4/.gz

    network_mode: host

docs.title: PreGME 控制器概述
docs.text: PreGME（Prescribed Performance Guidance and Management Estimator）是本项目的核心研究贡献，提供了一套完整的预设性能控制方案。

docs.title: 什么是预设性能控制（PPC）
docs.text:
预设性能控制是一种约束控制方法，通过预设的性能函数来限定系统的瞬态和稳态响应：

  • 收敛速度 — 误差必须在预定时间内收敛到邻域
  • 超调限制 — 响应超调不能超过预设边界
  • 稳态精度 — 最终误差必须小于预定阈值

docs.title: VisionFlow-PX4 Developer Manual
docs.text: A customized PX4 Autopilot fork developed by WindyLab, integrating UAVs with robotic arms (Gamma series) for manipulation tasks in Gazebo simulation, featuring Prescribed Performance Guidance and Management Estimator (PreGME) control and ROS2 integration.

docs.title: Core Features
docs.text:
• PreGME Controllers — Full replacement of standard mc_att_control and mc_pos_control with sliding-mode Prescribed Performance Control (PPC) algorithms, including centroid compensation and composite error state observer (CESO)
  • Gamma Arm Integration — Tight coupling between PX4 flight control and Gamma-series robotic arm dynamics via the gamma_arm_dynamics library
  • Rich Gazebo Simulation — Custom worlds, models, and plugins for indoor laboratory manipulation scenarios (landing boxes, VLA tasks, hardware-in-the-loop)
  • ROS2 Ecosystem — Zenoh middleware, uXRCE-DDS client, and a complete ROS2 Humble Docker environment

docs.title: Key Differences from Stock PX4
docs.text:
1. PreGME Controllers — Sliding-mode PPC replaces standard MC controllers (core research contribution)
  2. Robotic Arm Integration — gamma_arm_dynamics bridges PX4 flight control with Gamma-series arm dynamics
  3. Heavy Gazebo Simulation — Custom worlds, models, plugins for indoor lab manipulation
  4. ROS2 Integration — Zenoh middleware, uXRCE-DDS, Gazebo-ROS bridge, complete ROS2 Humble Docker
  5. Camera Feedback Pipeline — OAK-D and Intel RealSense support with geotagging
  6. Differential Rover Support — Full rover control stack alongside quadcopter

docs.text: uORB (micro Object Request Broker) is PX4's internal message bus, using a publish-subscribe pattern.

docs.title: Zenoh Middleware
docs.text: Zenoh is a lightweight alternative to DDS, suitable for resource-constrained environments.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Low overhead, suitable for embedded deployment
  • Supports both publish-subscribe and request-reply modes
  • Interoperable with standard DDS

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text: The Zenoh module is located at src/modules/zenoh/ and communicates with the flight control core via uORB messages.

docs.title: uXRCE-DDS Client
docs.text: uXRCE-DDS implements DDS communication over serial links (UART/CAN/USB).

docs.title: Use Cases
docs.text:
• Bridge PX4 data to remote ROS2 nodes
  • Support real-time control in low-bandwidth environments
  • Communication channel for hardware-in-the-loop simulation

docs.title: PreGME Controllers
docs.text: PreGME (Prescribed Performance Guidance and Management Estimator) is the primary research contribution of this project.

docs.title: Prescribed Performance Control (PPC)
docs.text:
PPC maps constrained errors to an unconstrained space through transformation functions, ensuring that system responses always remain within prescribed performance bounds:

  • Convergence Rate — Controls the error convergence rate through prescribed functions
  • Overshoot — Strictly limits maximum overshoot
  • Steady-State Accuracy — Guarantees final error is less than a predetermined threshold

docs.title: Composite Error State Observer (CESO)
docs.text:
CESO estimates and compensates for system uncertainties and external disturbances:

Estimate Description Inertia Matrix Online estimation of aircraft inertia parameter variations Disturbance Observation Estimates wind disturbances, arm reaction forces, etc. Trajectory Prescription Supports multiple prescribed trajectory modes

docs.text:

docs.title: Dual Controller Coexistence
docs.text: Standard PX4 controllers (mc_att_control / mc_pos_control) and PreGME controllers (pregme_att_control / pregme_pos_control) coexist simultaneously. The active controller is selected via the airframe configuration.

docs.title: Modular Architecture
docs.text: Each control function is implemented as an independent PX4 module, communicating via uORB messages. This design enables: - New controllers to be developed in parallel without affecting existing functionality - Sensor simulators to operate independently from control logic - Arm integration to be implemented through independent Gazebo plugins

docs.title: Lockstep Scheduler
docs.text:
To ensure precise temporal synchronization in simulation, all simulation configurations enable the lockstep scheduler:

EXTRA_CMAKE_ARGS="-DENABLE_LOCKSTEP_SCHEDULER=ON"

The lockstep scheduler ensures: - PX4 control loops are strictly aligned with Gazebo simulation steps - Sensor data is published at the correct simulation time - Actuator commands are applied to the physics engine at the correct time

docs.title: Key compose.yaml Configuration
docs.text:
services:
  px4-humble-gz:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: docker/Dockerfile.humble-gz
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              capabilities: [gpu]
    volumes:
      - ..:/workspace:rw
      - ccache:/home/px4/.ccache
      - gz_cache:/home/px4/.gz
    shm_size: '2gb'
    privileged: true
    network_mode: host

docs.title: Slow Build
docs.text:
Use ccache to speed up subsequent builds:

# Clear cache and rebuild
docker volume rm visionflow-px4_ccache
bash docker/run_gz_sitl.sh --build

docs.title: GPU Not Recognized
docs.text:
Ensure NVIDIA Container Toolkit is installed:

# Check installation
nvidia-smi

# Install (if not installed)
distribution=$(. /etc/os-release;echo $ID$VERSION_ID)
curl -s -L https://nvidia.github.io/nvidia-docker/$distribution/nvidia-docker.repo | sudo tee /etc/yum.repos.d/nvidia-docker.repo
sudo yum install -y nvidia-docker2
sudo systemctl restart docker

docs.title: UCDR Header Stall
docs.text:
You may encounter uORB ucdr header stalling during simulation startup. The system will automatically retry and recover. For manual intervention:

# Clear stale cache
bash docker/run_gz_sitl.sh --build --clean

docs.title: GUI Not Displaying
docs.text:
Ensure the DISPLAY environment variable is correctly set and the Docker container is allowed to access the X server:

xhost +local:docker

docs.title: Docker Method (Recommended)
docs.text:
For most users, the Docker method is recommended to get a complete environment:

# Build Docker image
bash docker/run_gz_sitl.sh --build

# Launch
bash docker/run_gz_sitl.sh --profile "Entity 1"

The Docker image comes with all necessary dependencies pre-installed, including ROS 2 Humble, Gazebo Harmonic, PX4 build tools, and custom plugins.

docs.title: Quick Verification
docs.text: After completing installation and launch, verify that the environment is working properly through the following steps.

docs.title: 1. Verify Docker Environment
docs.text:
# Check if Docker is running
docker info

# Check if NVIDIA GPU is available
docker run --rm --gpus all nvidia/cuda:12.2-base nvidia-smi

docs.title: 2. Verify PX4 SITL
docs.text:
# Enter Docker container
bash docker/into_gz_sitl.sh

# Check PX4 version
px4 --version

# List available simulation targets
ninja -C build/px4_sitl_default -t targets | grep "^gz_"

docs.title: 3. Verify Gazebo Simulation
docs.text:
# Launch minimal simulation
gz sim -r Tools/simulation/gz/worlds/laboratory_landingbox.sdf

You should see a Gazebo window open, displaying the laboratory scene.

docs.title: 4. Verify ROS 2 Bridge
docs.text:
In another terminal:

# Start data bridge
bash windshape_dev/data_stream/gz_bridge/bridge_gz_ros.sh

# Check topics
ros2 topic list

You should see bridged topics such as /gz/camera/... and /camera/....

docs.title: 5. Verify QGroundControl Connection
docs.text:
After launching QGroundControl, it should automatically connect to PX4 SITL (default UDP port 14550).

Check connection status: - Vehicle status shows "Ready" - Sensor data can be viewed - Control commands can be sent

docs.title: 6. Verify Arm Control
docs.text:
# Launch Gamma arm web control
bash windshape_dev/arm_control/gamma_arm/gamma_arm_web_control.sh

Open the displayed address in a browser; you should see the arm control panel.

docs.title: Verification Checklist
docs.text:
• Docker image built successfully
  • Gazebo scene loads correctly
  • PX4 SITL runs without errors
  • ROS 2 topic bridging works correctly
  • QGroundControl can connect
  • Arm control interface is accessible
